207:The roster table supports bulk role assignment: row checkboxes allow multi-select, a header checkbox provides select-all/deselect-all (with indeterminate state when partially selected), and a bulk action bar appears when any volunteers are selected.
263:The pre-publish surface is [[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/-components/judges/rotation-timeline.tsx]] — a coverage grid of heats × lanes where organizers click a cell or "Add" to plan a judge's rotation across heats. Crew heat numbers are not guaranteed to start at 1 (the Heats setup UI has a global starting-heat control, see [[crew#Heats Page]]) and may have gaps, so the timeline keeps two spaces: the grid geometry runs in 1-based **display-index** space while stored rotations and the editor form fields (`startingHeat`) run in **actual heat-number** space. The timeline's `displayToHeatNumber` / `heatNumberToDisplay` maps convert at every boundary — cell clicks and rotation drops convert display→actual before reaching the editor, editor preview cells convert actual→display before matching grid keys, and column headers render actual heat numbers. 2	import { strFromU8, unzipSync } from "fflate"
3	import { buildTabularParseResult } from "./tabular"
4	import type { CsvParseResult, ImportIssue } from "./types"
5	
6	const MAX_ENTRY_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024
7	const MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024
8	
9	interface ParseXlsxOptions {
10	  maxRows?: number
11	}
12	
13	interface SheetRow {
14	  rowNumber: number
15	  values: string[]
16	}
17	
18	type DateStyleKind = "date" | "time" | "dateTime"
19	
20	export function parseXlsx(
21	  input: Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer,
22	  options: ParseXlsxOptions = {},
23	): CsvParseResult {
24	  const fileIssues: ImportIssue[] = []
25	  let files: Record<string, Uint8Array>
26	  let totalBytes = 0
27	  let exceededSizeCap = false
28	
29	  try {
30	    files = unzipSync(
31	      input instanceof Uint8Array ? input : new Uint8Array(input),
32	      {
33	        filter: (file) => {
34	          if (!isReadableEntry(file.name)) return false
35	          if (file.originalSize > MAX_ENTRY_BYTES) {
36	            exceededSizeCap = true
37	            return false
38	          }
39	          totalBytes += file.originalSize
40	          if (totalBytes > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) {
41	            exceededSizeCap = true
42	            return false
43	          }
44	          return true
45	        },
46	      },
47	    )
48	  } catch {
49	    return emptyWorkbookError("Excel workbook could not be opened.")
50	  }
51	
52	  if (exceededSizeCap) {
53	    return emptyWorkbookError("Excel workbook is too large to import.")
54	  }
55	
56	  const workbookXml = readZipText(files, "xl/workbook.xml")
57	  if (!workbookXml) {
58	    return emptyWorkbookError("Excel workbook is missing workbook metadata.")
59	  }
60	
61	  const worksheetPath = getFirstWorksheetPath(files, workbookXml)
62	  if (!worksheetPath) {
63	    return emptyWorkbookError("Excel workbook does not include a worksheet.")
64	  }
65	
66	  const worksheetXml = readZipText(files, worksheetPath)
67	  if (!worksheetXml) {
68	    return emptyWorkbookError("Excel worksheet could not be read.")
69	  }
70	
71	  const sharedStrings = parseSharedStrings(
72	    readZipText(files, "xl/sharedStrings.xml"),
73	  )
74	  const dateStyles = parseDateStyles(readZipText(files, "xl/styles.xml"))
75	  const sheetRows = parseSheetRows(worksheetXml, sharedStrings, dateStyles)
76	  const headerIndex = sheetRows.findIndex((row) =>
77	    row.values.some((value) => value.trim().length > 0),
78	  )
79	
80	  if (headerIndex === -1) {
81	    return buildTabularParseResult({
82	      headers: [],
83	      dataRows: [],
84	      fileIssues,
85	      maxRows: options.maxRows,
86	      sourceLabel: "Excel sheet",
87	    })
88	  }
89	
90	  const headers = sheetRows[headerIndex]?.values ?? []
91	  const dataRows = sheetRows.slice(headerIndex + 1).map((row) => ({
92	    rowNumber: row.rowNumber,
93	    values:

95	        ? [...row.values, ...Array(headers.length - row.values.length).fill("")]
96	        : row.values,
97	  }))

101	    dataRows,
102	    fileIssues,
103	    maxRows: options.maxRows,
104	    sourceLabel: "Excel sheet",
105	  })
106	}

108	function emptyWorkbookError(message: string): CsvParseResult {
109	  return {

111	    rows: [],
112	    fileIssues: [{ code: "invalid_workbook", severity: "error", message }],
113	    skippedRowCount: 0,

117	function isReadableEntry(name: string) {
118	  return (
119	    name === "xl/workbook.xml" ||
120	    name === "xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels" ||
121	    name === "xl/sharedStrings.xml" ||

132	function getFirstWorksheetPath(
133	  files: Record<string, Uint8Array>,
134	  workbookXml: string,
135	) {
136	  const sheetTag = workbookXml.match(/<sheet\b[^>]*>/)?.[0]
137	  const relationshipId = sheetTag
138	    ? getAttribute(sheetTag, "r:id") || getAttribute(sheetTag, "id")
139	    : null

141	
142	  if (relationshipId && workbookRelsXml) {
143	    const relationship = findRelationship(workbookRelsXml, relationshipId)
144	    if (relationship?.target) return resolveWorkbookTarget(relationship.target)

152	  let match = relationshipPattern.exec(relsXml)
153	
154	  while (match) {
155	    const tag = match[0] ?? ""
156	    if (getAttribute(tag, "Id") === relationshipId) {
